latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of clawx: agent verification via ClawX OAuth.

- Provides an API to check agent verification status and trust tier.
- Supports three verification tiers: unverified, human-backed, and premium (quality).
- Includes an embeddable JavaScript widget to display verification badges.
- Offers usage examples for verifying agents and displaying trust indicators.
- Documents API rate limits and integration notes.
